status.description: Where the assessment stands. cause found: the evidence shows the root cause, and the notes propose a fix. cause likely: the evidence points at a cause it does not prove; the notes say what would settle it. not reproduced: nothing you can read shows the bug. needs a human: something only Dr K can see, decide or grant.

plan.description: true only when the fix needs a plan before the code: a particularly nasty bug, whose fix spans several components or a migration, must be done in a safe order, or has design choices for Dr K. Leave it out for any fix the report can state as a cause, a change and a regression test.
